name: DomainGuard 2.88
body:
DomainGuard 2.88

- Fixed the number beside an app remaining stale after clearing its access history. The count now refreshes after clearing, including with live updates paused, and follows new traffic without resetting searches or scrolling.
- Fixed grouped domain alerts losing their status-bar icon when grouped with the quiet protection notification. Notification visibility follows the existing Android channel settings.

Install DomainGuard.apk from the assets below. Corresponding GPLv3 source and SHA-256 checksums accompany this release.

name: DomainGuard 2.87
body:
DomainGuard 2.87

- DomainGuard status and alerts now share one expandable notification group on Android 7 and newer.
- Clear all dismisses alerts while keeping protection, rules, traffic history and active downloads. New attempts can notify again.
- Domain alerts have two buttons: Allow for [app name] for the quick action, and Allow options for the full rule dialog above your current app.
- Allow options lets you select a parent domain, apply the rule globally or make it temporary. The usual rule delays and explicit-block safeguards still apply. Cancel or Back returns to your previous app without saving.

Install DomainGuard.apk from the assets below. Corresponding GPLv3 source and SHA-256 checksums accompany this release.

name: DomainGuard 2.86
body:
DomainGuard 2.86

- Added a Filter button to Recent traffic using the main screen's familiar dialog.
- Filter by the app's default access (all, allowed or blocked), app type (all, user or system), and whether to include disabled apps. The traffic-only screen omits with/without-attempts and internet-permission filters.
- Apply changes this session. Set as default saves separate Recent traffic defaults; Reset restores them without changing the main screen's defaults, Hide allowed, hidden apps, sorting or the time window.
- Filters apply before the row limit, including after live traffic and app-rule changes. Apps sharing a network identity are included when any associated app matches all selected choices.

Install DomainGuard.apk from the assets below. Corresponding GPLv3 source and SHA-256 checksums accompany this release.

name: DomainGuard 2.85
body:
DomainGuard 2.85

- Recent traffic now combines the same access records shown under individual apps. It works without enabling detailed recording or adding a logging rule.
- Repeated attempts update their existing access record and latest time instead of adding a separate row for every request.
- Added the usual Hide allowed domains button. It starts from your global display setting and can be toggled for this session without changing that default.
- Rule icons, including global allow/block indicators, and domain colors now match the per-app lists.
- The three-minute default window, sorting, hidden apps, domain actions and live-update scroll protection remain available.

Install DomainGuard.apk from the assets below. Corresponding GPLv3 source and SHA-256 checksums accompany this release.

name: DomainGuard 2.84
body:
DomainGuard 2.84

- Added Menu > Recent traffic: one combined timeline across apps, with a separate row for every recorded attempt, including repeats.
- Starts with the last three minutes, newest first. Change the time window or sort order to review older recorded traffic.
- App icons and eye buttons let you hide an app from this view; Hidden apps restores it. Logging and protection stay unchanged.
- Tap an attempt for Allow, Block or Copy. Existing rule delays and temporary-rule options still apply. Live updates preserve the original tap target and your position when reviewing older attempts.
- Shows the recording status and explains how to enable detailed recording when needed. New eye icons are included in the Legend.
- Reduced repeated database reads while searching and filtering domains.

Install DomainGuard.apk from the assets below. Corresponding GPLv3 source and SHA-256 checksums accompany this release.

name: DomainGuard 2.83
body:
DomainGuard 2.83

- Updated in-app update handling.
- Cleaned up release documentation.

Install DomainGuard.apk from the assets below. Corresponding GPLv3 source and SHA-256 checksums accompany this release.

name: DomainGuard 2.82
body:
DomainGuard 2.82

- Fixed the disabled parent-domain dropdown for release-assets.githubusercontent.com and similar shared-hosting addresses. The dropdown now offers githubusercontent.com without requiring you to edit the address first.
- Parent choices still exclude registry endings such as com and co.uk. Selecting a parent continues to include its subdomains and follows the usual rule delay.

Install DomainGuard.apk to update in place. Corresponding GPLv3 source and SHA-256 checksums accompany this release.

name: DomainGuard 2.81
body:
DomainGuard 2.81

- The circular-arrow Reset button clears searches and restores your saved filter defaults. A saved User apps choice remains selected, and your sort order stays unchanged.
- Copy domains across apps respects the main domain search, each app's own domain search, Hide allowed, and the rows included in each displayed list. Duplicate domains are copied once. Each app now has its own Copy domains icon beside its domain tools.
- Empty cross-app domain searches say: No matching domains logged in any apps.
- Compact domain lists has an on/off switch directly in Display settings. Tap its name to choose the maximum height and try the full-screen example. The height dialog has no switch, and saving the height does not enable or disable compact mode.

Install DomainGuard.apk to update in place. Corresponding GPLv3 source and SHA-256 checksums accompany this release.

name: DomainGuard 2.8
body:
DomainGuard 2.8

- Raw Rules filters: select All rules or Global rules from the toolbar title. Each header has its own caret for Block, Allow and Other toggles, all on by default. Headers align left, carets right; Global other rules uses a plain globe. Filters only change what is displayed.
- The Rules list now includes Find, previous/next matches and a draggable right-edge scrollbar. Search respects the selected filters and never reveals partner secrets. Copy all and export still include all rules.
- Compact duration fields accept up to three digits before the decimal and two after it, with an adjacent fixed-width unit picker. Delays, pauses and temporary rules automatically round to the nearest second; .5 rounds up. Readable times show days, hours, minutes and seconds as needed. The seven-day limit and normal rule delays remain in force.
- Icon press feedback is 36dp; selected toggles use a borderless 32dp background while keeping their existing touch targets. Per-app search and Hide allowed show their selected state. Domain rows have balanced padding.
- Apps matching the main domain search remain visible when a search within that app has no matches, with a message naming the local query.

Install DomainGuard.apk to update in place. Corresponding GPLv3 source and SHA-256 checksums accompany this release.

name: DomainGuard 2.7
body:
DomainGuard 2.7

- Pause DomainGuard for every app from the main switch: turn on Resume automatically, choose seconds, minutes, hours or days (up to seven days), and confirm Pause. Leave it off to turn protection off until you enable it again.
- Pending and active global pauses show a subtle countdown strip with a short Cancel or Resume action. Both open a Yes/Cancel confirmation; the exact start/end time includes month, day and seconds.
- The turn-off/pause and allow-app confirmations show the applicable delay in the same expandable notice strip. Existing rules continue during the wait.
- Info & controls > Rule delay lets an app use the general delay or override it with a longer or shorter one. Increasing is immediate; reducing waits the difference (6 hours to 4 hours waits 2 hours). Returning to a shorter general delay follows the same rule.
- Global pauses, global allows and turning protection off respect the longest applicable app delay. Shared-UID pauses respect the stronger app delay.
- Pauses preserve existing rules and restore them automatically, including existing TCP/UDP connections at expiry. Manually turning protection off clears its old global pause so the next enable starts protected.

Install DomainGuard.apk to update in place. Corresponding GPLv3 source and SHA-256 checksums accompany the release.

name: DomainGuard 2.6
body:
- Domains and Info & controls tabs replace the per-app three-dot button. One panel is shown at a time, so app controls are immediately reachable even with a long domain list. The active tab is underlined, and domain tools wrap on narrow screens or with larger text.
- Display settings > App list > Open Info & controls by default chooses the starting panel. Each app can override it for the session. Domain searches open Domains so matching results stay visible.
- Narrow strips beside each domain list scroll the whole app screen. Swiping inside an overflowing compact list scrolls its domains.
- Domain lists have a subtle background tint: lighter in dark themes and darker in light themes.

Install DomainGuard.apk to update in place. Corresponding GPLv3 source and SHA-256 checksums accompany the release.

name: DomainGuard 2.5
body:
DomainGuard 2.5

- Temporary Allow and Block for domains and IP addresses, per app or globally. Enable Temporary and choose seconds, minutes, hours or days, up to seven days. Allows wait for the normal delay; blocks start immediately. The duration starts when the rule becomes active. Expiry removes only that temporary rule and leaves permanent rules and traffic history intact. Existing blocks still take priority over allows. Global lists show remaining time.
- Compact domain lists in Display settings: choose a height from 2 to 10 rows, with a scrollbar for longer lists. Tap the example app for a full-screen Preview with a Back arrow. Previewing does not save settings or create traffic history.
- Paused apps show a green Play/Resume button instead of the red Pause button.
- Live updates now clearly describes pausing only the displayed traffic updates for all apps. Logging and filtering are unchanged.
- The access-history trash icon is beside the app Pause and gear controls.
- Open the unchanged Legend through Help & tutorials. Done or Back returns to Help. Resume and Live updates controls are explained in the Legend.

Install DomainGuard.apk to update in place. Corresponding GPLv3 source and SHA-256 checksums accompany the release.

name: DomainGuard 2.4
body:
- Renamed the app to **DomainGuard**.
- **Compact toolbar and expanded apps:** Search, Filter and Sort stay in the top toolbar; app count and Reset appear only when filtering. Expanded apps put domain tools together, with app details under Options. Buttons are frameless.
- **Consistent action colors:** Add, Agree, Save, Apply and Resume use green; Delete, Remove, Cancel pending and Pause use red; plain Cancel and Done use gray. Shades adapt to light and dark themes.
- **Main-screen domain search:** hold Search to choose apps or domains. Domain mode uses the normal app layout, expands matching apps, and copies every distinct matching domain. Switching modes retains separate queries. Restoring a query does not summon the keyboard.
- **Central global lists:** an icon-labelled Blacklist/Whitelist chooser, search and add controls, separate bulk-add dialogs, consistent pending timers, and Back/Done navigation to the chooser.
- **Allow/Block dialogs:** a plain globe toggles Apply globally off/on. The parent-domain dropdown is connected to the input and lists every parent down to the registrable domain, using an offline Public Suffix List. Delay notices reflect the selected action and scope.
- **Display settings:** consolidated appearance and domain-list controls, the approved Hide allowed icon, and exact timestamps with day-of-month and seconds or optional elapsed time. Per-app domain search starts hidden; tap the magnifying glass to open it, or enable Always show domain search per app.
- **Pause DomainGuard for an app:** choose seconds, minutes, hours or days, up to seven days. The normal rule delay applies before the pause begins. While paused, all of that app's traffic is allowed, including global and app-specific blocks; existing rules are retained and restored automatically afterward. Pending pauses show their duration and start time, with Cancel pending pause directly below. Active pauses offer a green Resume now button below the end time. Android apps sharing a network UID pause together, with a notice in the dialog. The red pause icon is explained in the Legend.
- **Filter and sort defaults:** Set as default stays separate from confirmation buttons; Filter has Reset on the right, and applicable sort directions share the selected criterion's row.
- **Rule delay:** units and readable duration, with help in the top-right corner.
- **Updates:** one Install update action and a compact history control. History retains all published MW releases and DomainGuard releases, including full versions and dates.
- **Device backup:** Automatic backup toggle, phone backup settings link, and an information dialog. Android controls timing and restore; there is no manual backup-request button.
- **Legend and help:** grouped icon descriptions, a persistent scrollbar when needed, and Help & tutorials in the menu.
- **Notify on global blocks:** off by default. Enable it to include global-rule blocks in access notifications; other block notifications continue normally.
- **Raw rule editor:** literal search with previous/next matches and a draggable right-edge scrollbar. Navigation preserves the entire document; there are no top/bottom shortcut buttons.
- **Traffic history:** changing global blocks retains existing access logs.

Install 2.4 using its direct APK link once: the old MW updater recognizes only MW version tags. Future DomainGuard releases are supported by the new updater.

name: HeartGuard-MW 2.317-mw.7
body:
HeartGuard-MW 2.317-mw.7 adds:

- Rule change delay now accepts seconds, minutes, hours or days. Unit labels use the singular or plural form, and the preview shows the exact duration. Existing delay rules still apply.
- Copy domains in Search domains across apps copies every matching domain once, one per line, including results outside the visible area.
- The Android account backup explanation now displays in full.
- Hide global block notifications in Settings > Options is optional and off by default. It suppresses access alerts for active global blacklist matches, including subdomains. Blocking and access history remain unchanged.
- Sort domains is now an icon beside Hide allowed domains in each expanded app, with the same sorting choices and Set as default button.
- Always show domain search per app in Settings > Options keeps search visible by default. Turn it off to open search with the magnifying glass on the same row. Tapping again clears and closes that app's search; search state stays with its app during the session.

Install the attached APK to update your existing MW app. The corresponding GPLv3 source and SHA-256 checksums are included below.

name: HeartGuard-MW 2.317-mw.6
body:
HeartGuard-MW 2.317-mw.6 adds:

- Search domains across apps from the app menu. Enter a domain or paste a URL to find matching recorded attempts across all apps, including apps hidden by your filters. Results show each app/domain's latest recorded outcome and update as traffic arrives.
- Search within the global whitelist and blacklist. Searches also find parent-domain rules covering a host, with a "Covers this domain" label.
- Done or Android Back from either global list returns to the Global lists menu.
- Show in toolbar if room keeps Filter and Sort together when there is space.
- Install update starts the download, verifies the APK, and opens Android's installation confirmation.

Install the attached APK to update the existing MW app. The corresponding GPLv3 source and SHA-256 checksums are included below.

name: HeartGuard-MW 2.317-mw.5
body:
Settings > Options > Sort and filter buttons now offers three placements: always visible above the app list (default), show in the toolbar if room, or menu only. Switching placement preserves the current search.

Filter apps now includes Set as default. Apply changes the current session only; Set as default also saves the selected filters for future sessions. Search text stays temporary. Reset filters clears the current filters and search without replacing saved defaults.

Install the attached APK to update the existing MW app. The corresponding GPLv3 source and SHA-256 checksums are included below.

name: HeartGuard-MW 2.317-mw.4
body:
HeartGuard-MW 2.317-mw.4

- Allow a blocked domain for its app directly from an expanded access notification. Each button stays tied to the displayed app and domain. Existing rule delays and explicit blocks still apply. Enable Settings > Options > Notify on internet access.
- Keep app searches, expanded apps and domain searches during rule updates. Live domain rows keep their identity, including while a finger is touching a row.
- Sort apps alphabetically by default, or choose recent activity, allowed first, blocked first or UID. Combine search and filters, see the result count, and reset filters. Search and sort domain lists separately. Set as default saves a chosen sort.
- Hide allowed domains globally, with a temporary toggle for each expanded app.
- Manage global whitelist and blacklist entries through Menu > Global lists. Red/green globe badges identify global rules, with both icons explained in the legend. Per-app block exceptions remain in force.
- Set the rule delay in seconds from Settings, with a readable duration and pending-change controls.
- Request Android account backup of settings, rules and the hosts file. Automatic requests after changes are optional and off by default. Android controls backup timing and restoration; this is not a Drive file or an exact schedule. Traffic history and downloaded APKs are excluded.
- Show the raw rule list scrollbar at the right edge.

The verified in-app updater and release-startup fix from mw.3 remain included.

name: HeartGuard-MW 2.317-mw.3
body:
HeartGuard-MW 2.317-mw.3

- Global whitelist: add domains or paste URLs in one place, for every app.
- Block for this app: explicit app exceptions override global and app-specific allows.
- Check for updates: download and verify a newer MW release, then confirm installation with Android.
- Keeps serialized firewall commands intact in the minified release build.

Existing rule delays, global DNS blocks and lockdown still apply. Domain rules include subdomains, not URL paths. The earlier search/scroll reset issue is not included.

The source archive contains the corresponding GPLv3 source and build instructions. The development repository is private.

name: HeartGuard-MW 2.317-mw.1
body:
Local preview — not published as a GitHub release.

# HeartGuard-MW 2.317-mw.1

Custom build based on https://github.com/hoodedpaladin/HeartGuard with an Allow globally action in the per-app domain menu. The existing commented-out Reset condition is preserved.

This bundle contains the source used for version 2.317-mw.1. The build overlay sets a separate app name and the application ID to heartguard.heartguard.main.mw so it can coexist with upstream HeartGuard. It uses the debug build configuration and a separate signing key. The search and scroll-position fix is not included.

name: HeartGuard-MW 2.317-mw.2
body:
Local preview — not published as a GitHub release.

# HeartGuard-MW 2.317-mw.2

A modified GPLv3 build of [HeartGuard](https://github.com/hoodedpaladin/HeartGuard),
which derives from [NetGuard](https://github.com/M66B/NetGuard).
Modifications for this version were made on October 20, 2026.

Version `2.317-mw.2` adds:

- **Global whitelist** in the main menu. Paste domains or HTTP/HTTPS URLs, one per
  line. Rules cover the host and its subdomains, across current and future apps.
  URL paths, ports and query strings are not separate firewall rules.
- **Block for this app** in the domain menu. This overrides global and app-specific
  allows. To remove an exception, delete its `block package:... host:...` rule
  from **Rules**. Existing rule delays still apply.
- **Check for updates** in the main menu. Downloads from the public MW GitHub
  release repository, verifies length, SHA-256, package identity, version and
  signing certificate, and opens Android's installer for confirmation.
- A non-debuggable release with the same application ID and signing key as
  the previous MW preview. NetGuard billing is disabled in this free non-Play build.

Global DNS blocks and lockdown remain in force. Domain matching depends on DNS
names observed by the VPN; a hostname is not recoverable from arbitrary encrypted
DNS traffic. This does not add URL-path filtering. Apps that are not routed through
the VPN cannot be filtered. Adding an app-specific block keeps fully allowed apps
inside the VPN so their domain exceptions can be checked.

The earlier search/scroll reset issue is not part of this release.
